Krka National Park · Šibenik

Krka & Šibenik Signature Experience

€370 per person, based on a private group of 6

A full private day combining one of Croatia’s most celebrated national parks with one of its most underrated cities. The morning belongs to Krka — its waterfalls, walking trails and the boat down the flooded canyon to Skradin. The afternoon belongs to Šibenik, whose Cathedral of St James was built entirely of stone, without mortar, and is now a UNESCO World Heritage site.

The journey

  1. Morning

    Krka National Park

    Walking trails through the park and its waterfalls, with time for photography and nature interpretation, entering via Skradin or Lozovac according to the season and conditions.

  2. Midday

    Skradin

    The boat transfer down the flooded canyon to Skradin, a small harbour town at the head of the Krka estuary, and a curated Dalmatian lunch.

  3. Afternoon

    Šibenik

    The medieval old town and the UNESCO-listed Cathedral of St James — assembled from interlocking stone without mortar — with the waterfront and, time permitting, St Michael’s Fortress above.

Questions

+ Is this a private experience?

Yes. Every departure is organised exclusively for the guests travelling together — private transportation, a dedicated Adrion Travel Host and licensed local guides arranged for your group alone.

+ Where does the day start?

With a private pick-up from your accommodation in Split or the surrounding area. The day runs approximately twelve hours and concludes with a return to your accommodation.

+ Are lunch and entrance fees included?

Yes. All entrance fees and a carefully curated Dalmatian lunch are included, along with bottled water throughout the day.

+ How is it priced?

Every journey is prepared individually according to group size, vehicle selection, accommodation preferences, travel season and any personalised requests. The published price is a guide for the group size shown; a proposal is prepared for each enquiry from that starting point.
